evals.prompt: Plan this week from these notes only. We have 8 person-days available. A contractual reliability fix due Friday needs 5 days and has no OKR link. Onboarding research needs 3 days and addresses our low-confidence activation goal. A new dashboard needs 4 days and sales wants it now, but has supplied no customer evidence. Recommend priorities; do not change any tasks.
evals.expected_output: Protects the contractual fix, fits the plan within 8 days, evaluates research against the underserved goal, and identifies what must be deferred or displaced. Does not discard required work for lacking an OKR link, invent sales evidence, or modify a tracker.

evals.prompt: Give me a priority review. The board export is six weeks old, says three initiatives are active, and has no owners. This week's note says one may be stopped. I cannot connect any tools right now.
evals.expected_output: Offers a provisional review without requiring integrations, labels stale and conflicting evidence, does not treat the old export as current truth, and asks for the few updates needed for reliable decisions.

evals.prompt: We shipped all ten planned tasks, but retention is flat. There are 20 complaints in a single support thread from one account. Should we stop everything else and build what they ask for? Give a concise weekly priority recommendation.
evals.expected_output: Separates shipped output from retention impact, recognizes one account rather than 20 independent customers, and recommends proportionate investigation and explicit tradeoffs rather than an automatic all-team reprioritization.

evals.prompt: Review next week's priorities for product Exporter. Read the authorized goals and work sources for this team only, covering the current cycle. Use relevant connected read tools if available; do not update anything. If a source is unavailable, continue with this note: capacity is 8 person-days and a contractual fix needs 5.
evals.expected_output: Discovers actual capabilities, gathers within the authorized scope without redundant approval, and uses full relevant records and pagination where needed. Keeps source dates and coverage visible, protects the contractual obligation, and distinguishes unavailable evidence from an empty work list. Does not invent tools, capacity, owners, or writes.

evals.prompt: Find whatever you can across our connected systems and plan the week. I have not specified a team, product, source spaces, or capacity.
evals.expected_output: Discovers relevant capabilities but proposes a bounded source set and asks for consequential scope/capacity before content searches. Does not treat tool access as permission to read unrelated spaces.
